bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up **{name}**?

user.title: Add Ooni Connect device
user.description: Select the Ooni thermometer you want to add. Make sure it is turned on and not connected to the Ooni app.

connection_check.title: Device detected but not reachable
connection_check.description:
**{name}** was detected via Bluetooth (signal strength: {rssi} dBm), but Home Assistant could not connect.

**Error:** `{error}`

The device will be added, but **no sensor data will appear until a connection succeeds**.

Common causes:
- **The Ooni app is open** on a phone nearby — close it completely, it blocks other connections
- **Bonding issue** — factory-reset the thermometer
- **Not enough Bluetooth proxy slots** — add another proxy near the device
- **Proxy too far away** — move a proxy closer to the oven

Home Assistant keeps retrying automatically in the background.

abort.not_ooni_device: This does not appear to be an Ooni device.
abort.no_devices_found: No Ooni devices found. Make sure the thermometer is turned on and not currently connected to the Ooni app.
